'''''Orar''''' was a [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protector]] assault ship that served as the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] at the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. Its name was the [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] word for "thunder".
